text.content:
library: raes-example-pattern-library
version: 1
requirement_refs:
- AUT-806
source_refs:
- examples/README.md
- docs/public/quickstart.md
- docs/explain/reference/canonical-reference-map.md
description: 'Domain-neutral RAES agentic-environment authoring library for non-normative
  examples, templates, and reusable patterns. Current examples are strongest in cyber;
  additional domains extend through their own profiles, assets, backends, and evidence
  requirements. SDL template bodies are parsed and semantically validated by the Python
  reference implementation, and experiment templates hold experiment-authoring-input-v1
  documents that its experiment authoring-input loader validates.

  '
surfaces:
  scenario:
    summary: Complete scenario authoring from topology through objective flow.
    worked_examples:
    - id: cloud-secret-cross-project
      path: examples/scenarios/cloud-resources/cloud-secret-cross-project.sdl.yaml
      source_refs:
      - specs/sdl/cloud-resource-access.md
      - examples/README.md
      validation_status: guidance
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Synthetic metadata and illustrative evidence references; no cloud deployment
        or certified access result.
      - Host sizing is omitted; the parser emits deployment advisories.
    - id: hospital-ransomware-surgery-day
      path: examples/scenarios/hospital-ransomware-surgery-day.sdl.yaml
      source_refs:
      - examples/README.md
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - infrastructure
      - features
      - entities
      - agents
      - relationships
      - content
      - conditions
      - objectives
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Does not deploy a hospital range or prove clinical exercise adequacy.
    - id: cross-backend-minimal
      path: examples/scenarios/cross-backend-minimal.sdl.yaml
      source_refs:
      - examples/README.md
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - infrastructure
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Does not exercise an OCI runtime or live libvirt/QEMU daemon and makes no
        infrastructure-equivalence or fidelity claim.
    templates:
    - id: minimal-validated-scenario
      path: examples/library/templates/scenario/minimal-validated-scenario.yaml
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - conditions
      - entities
      - agents
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - evidence_requirements
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Validation covers SDL structure and references; it does not show that a backend
        can realize the scenario.
    - id: segmented-network-scenario
      path: examples/library/templates/scenario/segmented-network-scenario.yaml
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - features
      - infrastructure
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Validation covers topology structure, addresses, and references; it does not
        show that a backend enforces the access rules or installs the feature.
    - id: parameterized-scenario
      path: examples/library/templates/scenario/parameterized-scenario.yaml
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - variables
      - nodes
      - infrastructure
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - The gate validates the authored body and does not instantiate it with any
        variable values.
    patterns:
    - id: scenario-reference-integrity
      path: examples/library/patterns/scenario-reference-integrity.yaml
      validation_status: guidance
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - entities
      - agents
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Covers reference resolution only, not backend realization.
  workflow:
    summary: Declarative workflow authoring over objectives and branch state.
    worked_examples:
    - id: satcom-release-poisoning-workflows
      path: examples/scenarios/satcom-release-poisoning.sdl.yaml
      source_refs:
      - examples/README.md
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - objectives
      - workflows
      - variables
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Does not implement a CI/CD backend or production release system.
    templates:
    - id: parallel-objective-workflow
      path: examples/library/templates/workflow/parallel-objective-workflow.yaml
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - conditions
      - entities
      - agents
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - evidence_requirements
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Validation covers the workflow graph and its references; no workflow is executed.
    patterns:
    - id: workflow-explicit-control-graph
      path: examples/library/patterns/workflow-explicit-control-graph.yaml
      validation_status: guidance
      sdl_sections:
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Covers workflow graph authoring only; it does not execute workflows.
  participant_behavior:
    summary: Participant action contracts, observation boundaries, behavior specifications,
      and agent bindings.
    worked_examples:
    - id: sem-208-participant-behavior
      path: implementations/python/tests/test_sem_208_participant_behavior.py
      source_refs:
      - docs/explain/sdl/validation.md
      validation_status: guidance
      sdl_sections:
      - agents
      - action_contracts
      - observation_boundaries
      - behavior_specifications
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - A pytest module rather than an SDL file; the test suite parses and validates
        its inline SDL, and this gate does not.
    templates:
    - id: action-contract-observation-boundary
      path: examples/library/templates/participant_behavior/action-contract-observation-boundary.yaml
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - entities
      - action_contracts
      - observation_boundaries
      - agents
      - behavior_specifications
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Validation covers the participant declarations and their references; it does
        not run a participant or show backend support.
    patterns:
    - id: participant-behavior-contract-binding
      path: examples/library/patterns/participant-behavior-contract-binding.yaml
      validation_status: guidance
      sdl_sections:
      - agents
      - action_contracts
      - observation_boundaries
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Covers declaring and binding contracts only; it does not show participant
        runtime behavior.
  task:
    summary: Task-oriented authoring using current objectives, conditions, and target
      refs.
    worked_examples:
    - id: port-authority-objective-tasks
      path: examples/scenarios/port-authority-surge-response.sdl.yaml
      source_refs:
      - examples/README.md
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - agents
      - conditions
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Does not implement OT control, safety validation, or port operations.
    templates:
    - id: single-objective-task
      path: examples/library/templates/task/single-objective-task.yaml
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - conditions
      - entities
      - agents
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - evidence_requirements
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - SDL has no first-class tasks section, and this objective is not an experiment-task-v1
        record.
      - No experiment-task-v1 template is shipped. Its required artifact checksum,
        byte size, and creation time must describe an author's real protocol artifact;
        this SDL template cannot supply them. Validate an authored task with raes
        semantic validate --contract experiment-task-v1.
    patterns:
    - id: task-as-objective-contract
      path: examples/library/patterns/task-as-objective-contract.yaml
      validation_status: guidance
      sdl_sections:
      - agents
      - conditions
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - SDL has no first-class tasks section, and an objective written this way is
        not an experiment-task-v1 record.
  run:
    summary: Run-oriented authoring with story, script, event, workflow, and objective
      windows, plus a pre-run experiment run plan.
    worked_examples:
    - id: hospital-run-story
      path: examples/scenarios/hospital-ransomware-surgery-day.sdl.yaml
      source_refs:
      - examples/README.md
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - injects
      - events
      - scripts
      - stories
      - objectives
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Story, script, and event timing is authored SDL; nothing is scheduled or run.
    templates:
    - id: timed-run-control
      path: examples/library/templates/run/timed-run-control.yaml
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - conditions
      - injects
      - events
      - scripts
      - stories
      - entities
      - agents
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - evidence_requirements
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - SDL has no first-class runs section; the template expresses a run with stories,
        scripts, and events, and nothing is scheduled or run.
    - id: seeded-run-plan
      path: examples/library/templates/run/seeded-run-plan.yaml
      contract: experiment-authoring-input-v1
      validation_status: validated
      intended_user: experiment-author
      limits:
      - Pre-run design only; nothing runs, and it is not an experiment-run-v1 record.
      - Without a supplied task, task_ref is unresolved. load_experiment_spec and
        parse_experiment_spec check the id and any declared version when passed task=ExperimentTaskModel.
        The seed is not an executable random-stream contract.
    patterns:
    - id: run-window-with-evidence
      path: examples/library/patterns/run-window-with-evidence.yaml
      validation_status: guidance
      sdl_sections:
      - injects
      - events
      - scripts
      - stories
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - SDL has no first-class runs section; the pattern maps a run onto stories,
        scripts, events, and objective windows.
  study:
    summary: Study-oriented authoring with observable conditions, objectives, and
      workflow protocol, plus a pre-run two-condition experiment design. Graded scoring
      is an experiment/evaluator-plane concern per ADR-073.
    worked_examples:
    - id: satcom-study-scenario
      path: examples/scenarios/satcom-release-poisoning.sdl.yaml
      source_refs:
      - examples/README.md
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - conditions
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - evidence_requirements
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - Declares observable conditions only; graded scoring and reward are outside
        the SDL per ADR-073.
    templates:
    - id: observational-study-protocol
      path: examples/library/templates/study/observational-study-protocol.yaml
      validation_status: validated
      sdl_sections:
      - nodes
      - conditions
      - entities
      - agents
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - evidence_requirements
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - SDL has no first-class studies section; graded scoring stays in the experiment/evaluator
        plane per ADR-073.
    - id: two-condition-study-design
      path: examples/library/templates/study/two-condition-study-design.yaml
      contract: experiment-authoring-input-v1
      validation_status: validated
      intended_user: experiment-author
      limits:
      - Pre-run design only; it is not an experiment-study-v1 record and declares
        no analysis plan.
      - Without a supplied task, task_ref is unresolved; task=ExperimentTaskModel
        checks its id and any declared version.
      - The loader checks every condition factor and level against this experiment's
        author-supplied declarations in every binding posture. This establishes local
        consistency; it does not validate domain meaning or resolve an ontology.
      - The required_parameters are descriptive data that bind no configuration target;
        binding_semantics explicit-required rejects them and needs binding descriptors
        instead (ADR-094).
    patterns:
    - id: observable-study-conditions
      path: examples/library/patterns/observable-study-conditions.yaml
      validation_status: guidance
      sdl_sections:
      - conditions
      - propositions
      - assertions
      - evidence_requirements
      - objectives
      - workflows
      intended_user: sdl-author
      limits:
      - SDL has no first-class studies section; graded scoring stays in the experiment/evaluator
        plane per ADR-073.
